not_closed: Entry cache membership plus routes does not identify actual concurrent L2/mirror supply or victim decisions.
Process read_bytes covers all files and readahead/accounting; software nvme_read_bytes includes page-cache hits. Neither is exclusive SSD waiting time.
Worker sums overlap and are nested in phase1; pread_merge is also in pread; D2H sync may wait for previous GPU work. Never add these as exclusive time.
Cache continuity and predecessor association do not isolate a cache-tier causal intervention.

Observation on allocates 15728640 device and 62914560 pinned bytes and adds copies/output. One paired launch per condition cannot yield subtractable pure overhead, significance, epsilon, or performance acceptance.
GPU/RSS/cgroup/file-cache counters do not establish a deduplicated 54GB physical-memory union.
